result.summary: The page is mostly functional, but there is a clear content/localization defect where a translation key is displayed as plain text instead of the intended title. One restaurant name is also truncated in the horizontally scrolling list, which is minor.

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the translated user-facing label (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Update the localization file or string mapping so the correct translated title is rendered, and add a fallback to avoid showing raw keys.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated with an ellipsis, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Increase card width, allow multi-line restaurant names, or show the full name on tap/title attribute to improve readability.
